Loop 052 — bounded MEDIUM static end-to-end readiness-chain audit (~15-25 minute class).

Goal:
Close the current static Relay readiness work by adding an independent end-to-end regression/audit across the already-accepted chain:
explicit provider configs + inventory
-> live readiness snapshot
-> human approval request packet
-> structural approval receipt.

This task MUST NOT add another production runtime layer. It is an integration/audit batch only.

Read first:
- src/providers/live_readiness_snapshot.py
- src/providers/live_readiness_approval.py
- src/providers/live_approval_receipt.py
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_READINESS_SNAPSHOT.md

- docs/RELAY_LIVE_APPROVAL_RECEIPT.md
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_BLOCKERS.md
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md

Allowed changed paths only:
- tests/relay/test_live_readiness_chain.py
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_READINESS_CHAIN_AUDIT.md
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md

Hard scope:
- tests/docs only
- no production implementation changes
- no workflow changes
- no GitHub API/client code
- no live probe
- no provider/model/API/auth/credential/billing/settings/permission operation
- no Merge

Required end-to-end tests:
1. Use the existing canonical static fixtures/policies. Do not duplicate or weaken production semantics.
2. UNKNOWN/unresolved inventory path:
   - snapshot remains BLOCKED_UNKNOWN
   - live_ready=false / dispatch_allowed=false / human_approval_required=true
   - approval packet remains BLOCKED_UNKNOWN / RESOLVE_BLOCKERS
   - approval_granted=false
   - a fabricated APPROVE_FIRST_LIVE_POC record cannot become STRUCTURALLY_VALID_APPROVAL_RECORD
   - final receipt remains BLOCKED_UNKNOWN / execution_authorized=false / provenance_verified=false
3. Synthetic complete-evidence path:
   - snapshot may reach READY_FOR_HUMAN_APPROVAL only
   - still live_ready=false / dispatch_allowed=false
   - approval packet may reach READY_FOR_HUMAN_APPROVAL + REQUEST_HUMAN_APPROVAL only
   - approval_granted=false
   - valid structurally-bound APPROVE_FIRST_LIVE_POC record may reach STRUCTURALLY_VALID_APPROVAL_RECORD only
   - provenance_verified=false / execution_authorized=false / dispatch_allowed=false / live_ready=false remain fixed
   - next action is VERIFY_DURABLE_HUMAN_PROVENANCE, not execution
4. REJECT and DEFER on the same ready approval packet:
   - NON_APPROVAL_DECISION
   - NO_LIVE_ACTION
   - all authorization/live flags false
5. APPROVE_FIRST_LIVE_POC with one_shot=false fails closed.
6. Hash binding chain:
   - snapshot_packet_sha256 must bind snapshot output
   - approval_packet_sha256 must bind approval packet and the same snapshot hash
   - structural approval record target hashes must match exact approval/snapshot hashes
   - tamper one hash at each boundary and prove fail closed
7. Determinism:
   - equivalent input dict key ordering produces identical snapshot, approval, and receipt hashes
   - two identical complete inputs produce byte-for-byte equivalent safe outputs
8. Evidence sensitivity without leakage:
   - change exactly one valid evidence_ref in a synthetic complete inventory
   - snapshot and approval hashes must change deterministically
   - output/renderers must not expose evidence_ref or its raw value
9. Renderer boundary:
   - snapshot/approval/receipt Japanese renderers must all keep live execution prohibited
   - receipt renderer must say human provenance is unverified and execution unauthorized
   - no recorded_at, raw URLs, provider_meta, route_evidence, reasons, or evidence_ref values may appear
10. Cross-layer tamper cases:
   - mutate ready snapshot state/dispatch flag/hash and prove downstream approval cannot safely advance
   - mutate approval packet approval_granted/provider keys/hash and prove receipt cannot safely advance
   - mutate receipt record scope/timestamp/target hashes and prove fail closed
11. No authorization word/state regression:
   - across the produced runtime mappings, there is no true execution_authorized, dispatch_allowed, live_ready, approval_granted, or provenance_verified state.
12. No real-world claim:
   - tests must clearly label complete evidence as synthetic fixture data
   - tests/docs must state this resolves zero real live blockers.
13. Add docs/RELAY_LIVE_READINESS_CHAIN_AUDIT.md with a concise chain diagram, verified invariants, and explicit terminal boundary:
   STATIC chain complete != human provenance verified != first live command authorized.
14. Update docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md with a PREPARED/static end-to-end chain-audit checkpoint only.
15. The audit should be useful as a future regression gate: if any lower layer starts granting approval/live/dispatch/provenance automatically, this test must fail.
16. Keep imports compatible with repository-root unittest discovery; do not depend on pytest or third-party schema packages.

Run focused test(s) first, then exactly once:
PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
python -m compileall -q src tests
git diff --check

Publish the normal Jules PR from the isolated work branch if green. Do not merge.
